project.name: Demo shared library
project.description:
A library module the demo application depends on, standing in for the domain or service module a real multi-module project keeps beside its application. It exists to be edited: it carries Java the running UI renders and a stylesheet the running page loads, so an apply into a sibling module can be verified in the browser rather than only in the daemon's own report.
Deliberately dependency-free - not even Vaadin. What is being tested is that the dev loop reaches another module at all, and a plain jar is the shape that proves it for every project rather than only for Vaadin ones.
